Slide 4 of 7: Use natural prompt parameters for AI motion graphics. Adjust motion smoothness, lighting, and camera style so the animation matches your brand tone instead of looking generic.

Slide 6 of 7: Review one frame before you publish. Check motion and lighting in a still image; tweak the prompt until it feels right for your customers.
